essential_caveats: null means unavailable, never zero; no missing rating was filled.
Jerseys are strings, 0 != 00; snapshot labels may be stale or numerically damaged.
Entire-season rosters of playoff-qualified teams, not actual playoff appearance lists.
Transaction-only and offseason associations do not establish games played; no inferred chronology.
NBA 2K26 contains mixed early/pre-release captures, not final-season or July 2026 game ratings.
Record absence (not_in_rating_scope) differs from an existing selected record with missing_record status.
